$jsonSchema.title: Event Reminders Schema - OWASP Compliant
$jsonSchema.description: A scheduled reminder for an upcoming event, fired by ReminderWorkflow (com.pml.identity.domain.model.EventReminder)

_class.description: Spring Data MongoDB's type hint. Written on every document by the mapping converter, so a validator with additionalProperties:false that omits it rejects every write the application makes — silently in tests, which use a template with no validator, and totally in production.

reminderAt.description: The next of the two ET-NTF-002 R5 offsets (24h/1h before eventStartsAt)

eventStartsAt.description: ET-NTF-002 R5 · when the event starts; reminders fire 24h and 1h before it
